blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The defense lawyers of former President Rodrigo Duterte are asking a trial chamber of the International Criminal Court (ICC) for another round of medical examinations that would allow a neurologist and other medical experts to formally assess the detained ex-leader ahead of his trial. The defense, led by counsel Peter Haynes, made the request even after noting that the three-member panel of experts appointed by Trial Chamber III had affirmed that Duterte has the capacity to stand trial and “endure months or years of hearings.” TC III Presiding Judge Joanna Korner had earlier told the defense to bring Duterte to […]...
